page.layout: One page of text, set in one block. Running head at the top centre. Catchword "INDEX" at the lower right, signature at the lower left. Greeting and signature lines centred below the text. No margin notes.

main_text.p: bis, nisi fortassis ex bibliotheca Opt. patris mei, scripta ad Ecclesiæ vsum accommodata, requirat: in certam spem venio, G.T.D. hanc dedicationem, vt significationem reuerentiæ & studij mei, ceu pro filij T.D. non minus gratam esse habituram, quàm si ab ipso patre meo D.H.Zanchio, p.m. profecta esset: & me in suorum clientum numero habituram, & paterno affectu prosecuturam & complexuram. Quod vt G.V.D. magis magisq; faciat, & me meosq; propinquos, ac Zanchy nomen & scripta sibi commendata habeat, etiam atque etiam oro. Deus Opt. Max. T.Cl. Ecclesiæ suæ, Reip. & nobis omnibus quàm diutissimè conseruet incolumem, saluam & fortunatam, ac de cælis indies copiosissimè toti familiæ vestræ benedicat. Amen. Dab. Neustadij. Eidib. Mart. Anno D.n.I. Christi 1593.

page.notes: Show-through from the facing page appears along the left edge and in the lower half; it was not transcribed. Long s written as plain s throughout. Initial Q of "Quod" and initial N of "Neustadij" are decorated capitals. The signature mark at the foot ("4 5") is set in italic and the final character is uncertain. "Dab." is printed as Dab. Some line-end hyphenation ("Eidib.") appears as printed.
